residual_risks: The same entrypoint serves both _render and _isr, and the new path override trusts x-vercel-isr. Whether clients can spoof this header through Vercel requires platform verification; if they can, ordinary serverless routes can be redirected to another Astro route.
testing_gaps: The ISR tests validate generated configuration but do not exercise an ISR invocation through the entrypoint, so they do not confirm that x-vercel-isr restores the requested route.
